title: XamlGen Generate Input
description: Input to the generate step. The caller constructs this document — typically by filling in scaffold output argument values — and passes it to the generator to produce XAML. Replaces the retired xamlgen-input.schema.json.

expressionLanguage.description: Expression language for all argument values in this document. Project-level setting from UiPath project.json (design.expressionLanguage). Determines which WF expression wrapper type the generator emits.

workflows.description: Full-file mode: one entry per output XAML file. Each workflow produces a complete <Activity x:Class="{name}"> document.

root.description: Fragment mode: a single unwrapped activity or container node. No x:Class, no file wrapper.

name.description: Workflow name. Maps directly to the XAML x:Class attribute.

activityId.description: Activity identifier. Must match activity-catalog activity.id. Format: {CLRFullName}@{sourceId}/{sourceVersion}.

arguments.description: Argument values keyed by CLR property name (scaffold output ArgumentDescriptor.name). In/InOut: expression string in the document's expressionLanguage. Out: variable name to bind.

slots.description: Structural child slots for activities that accept nested nodes (e.g. Body, Then, Else). Keys are CLR property names of members with memberKind 'child'.

variables.description: Variables scoped to this Sequence. Declared as Sequence.Variables in XAML. Binding targets for Out arguments within this scope.

name.description: Variable name. Used as the value in Out argument bindings within this Sequence's scope.

dataType.description: CLR type string (e.g. 'System.String', 'System.Data.DataTable'). Generator maps to x:TypeArguments via namespaceMappings.

defaultValue.description: Optional default value as an expression string in the document's expressionLanguage. null if no default.
